memories.content: The package manager for the build is pnpm workspaces with a frozen lockfile.
Deploys run through GitHub Actions on the main branch.
The daemon stores memories in SQLite with write-ahead logging.
Repository identity prefers the origin remote and falls back to a local hash.
Releases are published with release-please from conventional commits.
The dashboard binds to loopback only and is read-only.
Node 24 is the supported floor for the JavaScript client.
Recall returns at most six results by default and twenty on request.
Coffee machine cleaning is scheduled every Friday afternoon.
Prompt recall must never embed memories on the prompt path.
Forgotten memories keep an ID tombstone and cannot be resurrected by retries.
Scope policy admits transferable rows cross-repository only with explicit consent.
